defmodule Shop.Cart do
  @moduledoc """
  A shopping cart: items with prices, discounts and tax.

  Carts are plain structs; every function returns a new cart.
  """

  # Tax rates by country, kept in one place so tests can override them.
  @rates %{"PL" => 0.23, "DE" => 0.19, "US" => 0.0}

  defstruct items: [], discount: 0, country: "PL"

  @doc "Adds an item unless a line with the same sku exists, then bumps its quantity."
  def add(%__MODULE__{items: items} = cart, sku, price, qty \\ 1) do
    case Enum.find_index(items, &(&1.sku == sku)) do
      nil ->
        %{cart | items: items ++ [%{sku: sku, price: price, qty: qty}]}

      i ->
        updated = List.update_at(items, i, fn line -> %{line | qty: line.qty + qty} end)
        %{cart | items: updated}
    end
  end

  def remove(%__MODULE__{items: items} = cart, sku) do
    %{cart | items: Enum.reject(items, &(&1.sku == sku))}
  end

  @doc "Sum of line totals before discount and tax."
  def subtotal(%__MODULE__{items: items}) do
    items
    |> Enum.map(fn line -> line.price * line.qty end)
    |> Enum.sum()
  end

  def total(%__MODULE__{} = cart) do
    base = subtotal(cart) - cart.discount
    rate = Map.get(@rates, cart.country, 0.0)

    base
    |> max(0)
    |> Kernel.*(1 + rate)
    |> Float.round(2)
  end

  def empty?(%__MODULE__{items: []}), do: true
  def empty?(_), do: false

  defp apply_coupon(cart, "HALF") do
    %{cart | discount: div(subtotal(cart), 2)}
  end

  defp apply_coupon(cart, code) do
    if String.starts_with?(code, "FIX") do
      amount = code |> String.trim_leading("FIX") |> String.to_integer()
      %{cart | discount: min(amount, subtotal(cart))}
    else
      cart
    end
  end
end
